Paused views reopen through open when enabled; disposed views cannot reopen.
limits: Author is implementer /root/catalogue_view, not an independent evaluator.
VM fake DOM plus real shared catalogue contract only; no Electron execution, GUI, CSS/layout qualification, package build, Git mutation or release.
Parent owns main-service integration, security policy, disclosure/dialog mounting, focus leases and native admission.
Backend marker/history identity and historical hosted pan failure are outside this implementation evidence.
Async mutation may finish in main after cancel; cancelled renderer ignores its late result and does not claim rollback.
